label: TP
reason: User input from getParameterValues flows directly to bar via substring(0, length-1), which then becomes input bytes passed to MessageDigest digest(), converted back to string, encoded with encodeForHTML(), and printed to response. The substring operation preserves all potentially malicious characters except the last character, providing no meaningful protection against XSS.

evidence.note: User param flows through substring to bar, then to MD digest, then to HTML-encoded output in response
